decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building. The rear and flank walls of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be finished of in render.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 1296.2.01 and 1296.2.04 submitted 15 December 2010, 1296.2.05 submitted 28 February 2011and 1296.2.02 Rev C and 1296.2.03 Rev C submitted 23 March 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side and rear extension, a rear roof extension and the construction of an outbuilding
